async () => { const s = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame.getTestState(); return s.mail.account.id === 'guest' && s.mail.accounts.includes('jed_pc') && s.mail.folder === 'inbox'; }

message: N16: a highlighted span saves as evidence

fn: async () => { const s = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame.getTestState(); return s.mail.selectedId === 'welcome' && s.mail.highlights.includes('h_pwd'); }

async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const b = window.mailState?.mailboxes?.guest?.messages || []; if (b.some(m => m.id === 'later_notice')) return true; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); } return false; }

message: N15/found: switch to Jed's found account and read his history

fn: async () => { const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; mg.switchAccount('jed_pc'); const s = mg.getTestState(); return s.mail.account.id === 'jed_pc' && s.mail.messages.some(m => m.id === 'jed_in1'); }

async () => { const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; mg.setFolder('sent'); const s = mg.getTestState(); return s.mail.folder === 'sent' && s.mail.messages.some(m => m.id === 'jed_sent1'); }

message: N8: send to Wexley, her reply ends on choices

fn: async () => { const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; mg.switchAccount('guest'); mg.setFolder('inbox'); return mg.getTestState().mail.account.id === 'guest'; }

async () => { const c = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame.composer; c.selectContact('wexley'); c.chooseTemplate('pretext', 'pretext_generic'); const ok = c.send(); return ok === true && c.target.id === 'wexley'; }

async () => { const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; mg._dismissChecklist(); mg.closeCompose(false); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const b = window.mailState?.mailboxes?.guest?.messages || []; const reply = b.find(m => m.folder !== 'sent' && m.thread === 'wexley:guest'); if (reply) { mg._refresh(); mg.reader.select(reply.id); const s = mg.getTestState(); return !!(s.mail.followup && s.mail.followup.mode === 'choices' && s.mail.followup.options.length === 2); } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); } return false; }

message: N8: pick a reply option -> quickReply record + continuation

args: It's the Q3 export Ravi mentioned

fn: async () => { const sent = (window.mailState.mailboxes.guest.messages || []).filter(m => m.folder === 'sent' && m.kind === 'quickReply'); return sent.length === 1 && sent[0].body === "It's the Q3 export Ravi mentioned"; }

message: N8: continuation reply offers the judged composer (#compose_reply)

fn: async () => { const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const t = (window.mailState?.threads || {})['wexley:guest']; if (t && t.expects && t.expects.mode === 'compose' && t.expects.targetId === 'wexley_followup') { const box = window.mailState.mailboxes.guest.messages.filter(m => m.folder !== 'sent' && m.thread === 'wexley:guest'); const latest = box.sort((a, b) => (b.gameTime || 0) - (a.gameTime || 0))[0]; mg._refresh(); mg.reader.select(latest.id); const s = mg.getTestState(); return !!(s.mail.followup && s.mail.followup.mode === 'compose' && s.mail.followup.targetId === 'wexley_followup'); } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); } return false; }
